form.name: Application for Permit to Drill, Deepen, and Operate a Well (cover page); with Survey Record of Well Location and Supplemental Plat
form.number: EQP 7200-1 (survey EQP 7200-2; blowout control EQP 7200-4; injection EQP 7200-14)
form.notes: NOT READ: michigan.gov answered 403 to the caller's HEAD and to WebFetch GET (no retry, no workaround). Form number and title come from WebSearch result summaries of EGLE pages, not from the form. Filing is through the MiSTAR e-filing system per those summaries. Form cells are therefore taken from Mich. Admin. Code R 324.201 (read at law.cornell.edu/regulations/michigan/Mich-Admin-Code-R-324-201), marked evidence 'doc', and many are 'unknown'.

proposed_depth_tvd.n: R 324.201(3), directional wells only; layer TVD is empty on new permits

target_formation.n: ProducingFormation, ProdFormationCode; filled on 1 of 8 newest permits

fee.n: R 324.201(2)(j): statutory fee with the application

notice_hearing.n: R 324.201(2)(e): first page mailed to county clerk and surface owner in 7 days

date_received.n: Not in layers; weekly lists said to include 'applied for' (not read)

date_approved.n: PermitDate (newest 2026-10-07); read as the issue date, not confirmed

spud_date.n: No spud field in layers 9 and 10

plat_image.n: R 324.201(2)(b): signed, sealed survey and plat; online copy not verified

logs.n: LogsAvailable flag (YES/NO) only; logs themselves not checked

grade_reason: ArcGIS layers 9 and 10 are free, no login, answered 200 from here, hold one record per well with PermitNumber, api_num and PermitDate (newest 2026-10-07, so maintained). Michigan is a small market (69 records dated since 2025-01-01), so monthly counts are noisy. No work type, spud date or proposed depth in the data.
producer_plan: Query layer 10 (surface hole, has the point) page by page (maxRecordCount 2000, resultOffset supported) or ask for statistics, with fields api_num, PermitNumber, PermitDate, well_type, WellType, WellStatus, Slant, Sidetrack, Completion, CountyName, CompanyNo, CompanyName, FieldName, X, Y. Count wells by PermitDate month; split by well_type (LOC = permitted, not drilled; OIL/GAS = producers; GIW/WIW/BDW/COI/DH = injection, disposal and other service codes, codes not decoded). Work type is not a field: Sidetrack greater than 0 marks another wellbore on an existing hole and Completion greater than 0 a later completion, but this is inferred from the field names and sample rows, not documented. Caveats: PermitDate meaning (issue vs latest action) not confirmed; one record per well so a reissued or amended permit may not show as a second row; cancelled or expired permits may or may not stay in the layer (not checked); cadence of the layer unknown (shapefile page says nightly). The weekly PDFs (blocked here) could confirm dates.
privacy_notes: CompanyName is the permittee and the weekly PDFs carry permittee addresses (search summary); an operator can be an individual, so a build needs a corporate-name filter like the Oklahoma nameable() rule. No names or addresses copied here.
unknowns: cancelled and expired permits in the layer
spud and completion dates anywhere in the open data
